mainEntity.name: What does the onboarding process look like?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our onboarding team guides set up, training, and data migration in the background so your clinic stays operational from day one, with timing built around your chosen go-live date. You get dedicated onboarding, role-specific training sessions, video tutorials, and an ongoing success manager. Your dedicated, US-based success manager guides setup and training, with regular check-ins and quarterly reviews to keep your goals on track.

mainEntity.name: Is there ongoing support after go-live?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our support doesn't end at go-live, every account has an ongoing success manager, and we provide continued resources including advanced training, new release round-ups, and industry roundtables, plus a support center with help articles and contact options. Your support comes from our US-based team of licensed clinicians and certified billers, with dedicated contacts for clinical, billing, and EDI questions.

mainEntity.name: Are there self-serve training videos or Prompt University resources?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Prompt University is our dedicated learning hub with self-serve training. Alongside it, we provide video tutorials and on-demand videos that help new team members ramp up fast, plus a knowledge base of help articles.
